hunks.baseline: “It is a little old here.”
hunks.sol: “It is a bit old here.”

hunks.baseline: “But he somehow managed to survive and escape. The Nangong Family must have been watching him closely, too.”
hunks.sol: “But he did manage to survive and escape. The Nangong Family must have been watching him closely, too.”

hunks.baseline: They were one of the Five Great Families of the world, said to rival the Nine Sects and One Gang. As far as I could tell, catching and killing a single fugitive would have been nothing to them.
hunks.sol: They were one of the Five Great Families of the world, said to rival the Nine Sects and One Gang. I didn’t know the details, but catching and killing a single fugitive would have been nothing to them.

hunks.baseline: It was a significant choice of words. It also meant that the Jeok Cheongang of today was different.
hunks.sol: It was a telling remark. It also meant that the Jeok Cheongang of today was different.

hunks.baseline: I swallowed and opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I swallowed dryly and opened my mouth.

hunks.baseline: “So he is. In the end, that’s how it turned out.”
hunks.sol: “I see. In the end, it came to that.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang unconsciously tried to tip back his wineglass, then noticed that it was empty and gave a hollow laugh.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang absently tried to tip back his wineglass, then noticed that it was empty and gave a hollow laugh.

hunks.baseline: But Jeok Cheongang’s goal had not been fulfilled. Jopil encountered me before his former Master could reach him, and lost his life.
hunks.sol: But Jeok Cheongang’s goal had not been fulfilled. A step ahead of his old Master, Jopil had encountered me—and lost his life.

hunks.baseline: Suddenly, Jeok Cheongang’s lips twitched, as if he were someone saying such a thing for the first time.
hunks.sol: Suddenly, Jeok Cheongang’s lips twitched, as if it were the first time he had ever said such a thing to anyone.

hunks.baseline: It seemed surprising enough to me. And he looked incredibly uncomfortable himself, so what was he complaining about?
hunks.sol: It seemed surprising enough to me. And he was clearly just as uncomfortable himself, so what was he complaining about?

hunks.baseline: “The famous Fire King Jeok Cheongang, Great Hero, personally apologizing to a much younger junior like me! I can only bow before your broad-minded nature and humility.”
hunks.sol: “For the world-renowned Fire King, Great Hero Jeok Cheongang, to personally apologize to a junior as young as me! I can only bow before your magnanimous spirit and humility.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang expressed his intense inner conflict over whether to hit me through every muscle in his face. Eventually, he sighed.
hunks.sol: Whether to hit me or not, Jeok Cheongang expressed his intense inner conflict through every muscle in his face. Eventually, he sighed.

hunks.baseline: I desperately wanted to put things between Jeok Cheongang and me to rest after today.
hunks.sol: I was desperate to settle things with Jeok Cheongang once and for all today.

hunks.baseline: I turned around with a voice as tiny as an ant’s, then stopped short.
hunks.sol: In a voice as tiny as an ant, I turned around—and stopped short.

hunks.baseline: There was no one who remained strong forever, nor anyone who remained weak forever.
hunks.sol: No one is strong forever, and no one is weak forever.

hunks.baseline: Even Jeok Cheongang, a Supreme Peak master, was the weaker party to someone.
hunks.sol: Even Jeok Cheongang, a Supreme Peak master, is ultimately weaker than someone else.

hunks.baseline: Yet people occasionally forgot that fact. Drunk on their own strength—or on blood—they strayed down the wrong path.
hunks.sol: Yet there are those who mistake that fact. Drunk on their own strength—or on blood—they take the wrong path.

hunks.baseline: No—he had believed that was what he had been.
hunks.sol: No—he had believed it was so.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang had watched it from the closest distance, yet he hadn’t known.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang had watched it up close, yet he hadn’t known.

hunks.baseline: *Ah. The Jin Family of Taiyuan.*
hunks.sol: *Ah, the Jin Family of Taiyuan.*
